question:
Read the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R):

Assertion (A): Self-sufficiency guided India’s early economic planning.

Reason (R): The nation aimed to minimize reliance on external aid and imports.

options.text: Both true, R does not explain A

solution:
The correct answer is __**Both true, R explains A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Assertion (A): Self-sufficiency guided India’s early economic planning:**

 
 
• Post-independence, India adopted a policy of economic self-sufficiency to reduce dependency on foreign countries.
 
• The objective was to ensure **economic independence** by fostering domestic industries, agriculture, and infrastructure.
 
• This approach was evident in the emphasis on the **Second Five-Year Plan (1956-61)**, which prioritized heavy industries and public sector growth. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Reason (R): The nation aimed to minimize reliance on external aid and imports:**
 
 
• India's economic planning sought to limit foreign dependency by promoting domestic production and reducing imports.
